turns.question: Our books close on Amsterdam time. What was our revenue in September 2026, cancelled orders left out, counting each order on its calendar day in Amsterdam?
turns.answer: Revenue (non-cancelled orders) for 2026-09-01 to 2026-09-30 was EUR 12,582.75, but the semantic layer only assigns orders to UTC calendar days and has no Amsterdam-time option, so this figure is on UTC days, not Amsterdam days. Late: sales.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
